intro: Desi Dabba weekly meals are made for busy weekdays when you want fresh, comforting and balanced food without cooking every day.

mealOptions.title: Vegan Meals

mealOptions.title: Non-Vegetarian Meals

subscription.title: How the Weekly Plan Works
subscription.description: Choose your weekly meal plan before the order cutoff and enjoy fresh meals delivered from Monday to Friday.
steps: Choose your meal preference: vegetarian, vegan or non-vegetarian.
Confirm your weekly plan before the cutoff.
Receive fresh meals during the week.

delivery.description: Weekly meals are prepared fresh and delivered with care.
details: Order cutoff: Friday at 5 PM for the following week
Delivery area: Tallinn and nearby areas, based on availability

benefits.title: Fresh Weekly Menu

benefits.title: Balanced Meals
benefits.description: Each meal is planned with comfort, flavour and balance in mind.

benefits.title: Made in Small Batches

benefits.title: Flexible Plan

faq.question: Can I choose vegetarian meals only?
faq.answer: Yes. Vegetarian meal plans are available.

faq.question: Do you offer vegan meals?
faq.answer: Yes. Vegan options are available based on the weekly menu.

faq.question: Is non-vegetarian food available?
faq.answer: Yes. A non-vegetarian meal is served once a week.

faq.question: Can I skip or pause a week?
faq.answer: Yes. The plan can be paused with advance notice.

faq.question: Do you handle dietary notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Please share allergies, spice preferences or dietary restrictions before confirming your plan.

faq.question: What is a tiffin / dabba?
faq.answer: A tiffin, also called a dabba, is a reusable meal box used to carry fresh home-style food. At Desi Dabba, we deliver meals in a hot tiffin box that is microwave-safe and dishwasher-safe, making it easy to heat, eat and reuse.
